summary:
Our Vision & Purpose

Sending a rover or lander to Mars or the Moon takes years of work and billions of dollars. If that rover runs into unexpected terrain, harsh temperatures, or unfamiliar soil once it lands, a single failure can wipe out the entire mission and waste massive resources.

We built ANALOG//ATLAS to help prevent that loss before a rocket ever leaves the launchpad. By using real-time climate, elevation, and geological data, our platform helps scientists and engineers pinpoint the exact places on Earth that look and behave like Mars or the Moon—so they can test rovers, sensors, and equipment right here at home for a fraction of the cost.

Just as importantly, we wanted space exploration to feel close to home for the next generation. ANALOG//ATLAS doubles as an open, hands-on learning tool where students anywhere in the world can click on the map, explore their own surroundings, and discover that the ground beneath their feet shares real scientific traits with distant worlds.
